description: Phase A: Stability & Foundation - Prepare RhinoMCP for professional use

userStories.title: Add structured error codes to Python responses
userStories.description: As a developer, I need consistent error codes so I can programmatically handle errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Create rhinomcp/utils/errors.py with error code constants (e.g., CONNECTION_ERROR, INVALID_PARAMS, RHINO_ERROR)
Update rhinomcp/utils/responses.py to include error codes in error responses
Update at least 3 existing tools to use the new error format
userStories.notes: Start with create_object, get_document_info, and ping tools

userStories.title: Add connection health check with auto-reconnect
userStories.description: As a user, I want the server to automatically reconnect if the connection drops.
acceptanceCriteria: Add is_connected() method to RhinoConnection class
Add reconnect() method with configurable retry count and delay
Update send_command to attempt reconnect on connection errors
Test: disconnect Rhino plugin, verify reconnect works when restarted
userStories.notes: Keep it simple - max 3 retries with 1 second delay

userStories.title: Add missing C# handlers for annotation tools
userStories.description: As a developer, I need create_leader, create_text, create_text_dot to work end-to-end.
userStories.notes: Check if these already exist elsewhere or need to be created from scratch

userStories.title: Add basic pytest test suite for Python server
userStories.description: As a developer, I need automated tests to catch regressions.
acceptanceCriteria: Add test_responses.py testing ok() and from_exception()
Add test_connection.py with mocked socket tests
All tests pass: uv run pytest
userStories.notes: Focus on unit tests that don't require running Rhino

userStories.title: Add GitHub Actions CI workflow
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want automated checks on every push/PR.
acceptanceCriteria: Workflow triggers on push to main and PRs
userStories.notes: Start simple - just Python tests, no C# build yet

userStories.title: Add configurable timeout for script execution
userStories.description: As a user, I want to set custom timeouts for long-running scripts.
acceptanceCriteria: Add optional timeout parameter to execute_rhinoscript_python_code tool
Timeout can be set up to 120 seconds
